text: the brave bear runs near the fox .
the calm lion jumps near the deer .
the dark deer waits near the fox .
the calm bird flees near the owl .
the lazy wolf sleeps near the bird .
on the meadow a wolf rests .
on the river a owl jumps .
the fox waits for the small fox .
on the brook a lion hides .
a big dog jumps in the cave .
